Behind the image
45 / Taupe Shearling
REFERENCE 5798.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 034
Art direction: Quiet-luxury winter, soft taupe and cream, smartphone-style snapshot, city light.
Photorealistic vertical smartphone-style portrait of an original adult woman with straight
platinum-blonde hair parted in the center and a calm, cool gaze, sitting in the back seat of a car.
She wears a taupe oversized shearling jacket with a diagonal gold zipper and wide cuffs and a gold
ring. Through the window, a Parisian street with cream buildings and bare trees. Soft overcast city
light, quiet-luxury winter palette of taupe and cream, no text or logos.
46 / Theatre Bloom
REFERENCE 5801.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 035
Art direction: Theatrical romantic couture, rust and crimson against velvet red, checkerboard floor,
storybook stage set.
Full-length vertical theatrical fashion editorial of an original adult woman with curled copper-red
hair half pinned up, standing on a black-and-ivory checkerboard stage floor before deep red velvet
curtains. She wears a botanical jacquard mini dress with a sweetheart corset bodice, rust-red
straps and a dramatic rust ruffle across the waist over a full flared skirt, and matching jacquard
ankle-strap platform heels. Warm stage light, rust and crimson palette, storybook romantic
couture, no text or logos.
